Tokenomics 100 $CHART → 1 $RUN · 100M $RUN supply ▾
$CHARTSoft currency. Earned in-run from grunt kills, pickups & mode entries. Resets each run; your career tally persists. Front-loaded issuance — 500 → 200 floor per run.
$RUNHard currency. Scarce on-chain SPL on Solana. Mints only on a winning trade, a boss kill, or a mission complete. Daily mint cap 50 $RUN.
Swap100 $CHART → 1 $RUN at the in-run shop. Reserve float drifts 100:1 → 250:1 as the reserve drains (one-way). 2% swap tax.

Broker · connect once

Pick a venue family and broker, then Connect. Once connected, choose which API to route through when you activate a trade in-game.

Connections are saved and persist across sessions. No funds move and no live order routes — execution is paper/mock until Phase 2.

SDK

ChartRunnerSDK — the trading primitives that the game runs on. Same surface drops on top of Dexscreener / TradingView in Phase 1.

// Phase 0.9.8 — every ability calls into the SDK sdk.bracket({ side:'buy', price, slDistance:60, rr:2.0, risk:20 }) sdk.ladder({ side:'buy', rungs:5, spacing:30, size:4, price }) sdk.fibLadder({ side:'buy', size:4, price, base:60 }) sdk.oco({ upper:80, lower:-80, size:6, price }) sdk.hedgeParachute({ duration:6, side:'buy', price, risk:20 }) sdk.liquidityRadar({ range:320 }) sdk.rescueDrone() sdk.trailStop({ id, distance }) // v0.9.8 Tier 1+: market, limit, stopLoss, takeProfit, scaleOut, // twap, iceberg, trailingTakeProfit, ocoBracket, ifThen, // fundingSnipe, borrowShort, liquidationGuard, copyTrade, // perpFlip, comboTrade, autoFib, magnet, recordRun sdk.on('order', e => { /* { kind, order } */ }) sdk.on('fill', e => { /* { order, price } */ }) sdk.on('bracketClose', e => { /* { order, reason } */ })
Phase 1: drop the game UI as an overlay on Dexscreener charts (bookmarklet + ChartHost adapter). Phase 2: swap the mock backend for a Solana adapter.
